description: This file implements a command class for storing OAuth2 tokens in a database within the Superset project. It handles OAuth2 token exchange, PKCE code verifier retrieval, token storage, and error handling.

classes.name: OAuth2StoreTokenCommand
classes.description: A command class to handle storing OAuth2 tokens in the database, including token exchange, PKCE verification, and token cleanup.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with OAuth2 provider response parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the token storage process, including token exchange, PKCE code verifier retrieval, and token persistence.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input parameters and decodes the OAuth2 state.
